info.title: Reviews & Ratings API
info.description: Mode C API of Reviews & Ratings (SSPS v1). All data lives in the merchant's own database and photos in the merchant's own bucket. Times are ISO-8601 UTC. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`type` ends with a stable code). POSTs that create or move state require `Idempotency-Key`; replays return the original response. `pk_` keys (browsers, domain-locked) read public data and identify the customer with SS-Identity (the website's own login token) or a review link token; `sk_` keys are for the merchant's server.

get.summary: Reviews: pk_ → approved reviews (public view; needs the display element); sk_ → every review (owner view, filter[status]=pending,approved,rejected|all).
